summary: Frontend-only e2e verification of the new 'voice_capture' permission end-to-end. All four review scenarios PASSED. (1) Access editor renders 'Voice Box (Decision Desk capture)' toggle at data-testid='perm-voice_capture', OFF by default for Sales (Priya Nair) — visually white while ON perms like 'perm-inbox' use bg-brand-ink text-white. (2) Toggling it ON changed its class to the ON style, Save succeeded (toast 'Priya Nair's access updated'). Re-login as sales@sharma.com via Email & Password tab → Decision Desk now renders both voice-record-button and text-directive-input, and owner-only-notice is NOT present. (3) Revoke path: re-logged as owner, opened Sales access, toggled perm-voice_capture back OFF, saved successfully — clean demo state restored (Sales ends with voice_capture OFF). (4) Owner regression: owner still sees the full capture panel on Decision Desk (voice-record-button + text-directive-input present, no owner-only-notice). No console errors observed (only harmless Radix Dialog aria-describedby warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor a11y: the permission toggle buttons in /app/frontend/src/pages/Team.js (data-testid='perm-<key>') convey ON/OFF state only via background color classes (bg-brand-ink text-white vs bg-white) with no aria-pressed attribute. Consider adding aria-pressed={perms.includes(p.key)} so screen readers and automated tests can programmatically detect state (tests currently have to inspect className). Non-blocking.

Radix Dialog warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' fires when opening the member access dialog. Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Team.js MemberDialog for a11y compliance.
